Safe statement: A disease-signature pathway is directionally opposed after exercise.
Unsafe upgrade: Exercise reverses or treats the disease.

Safe statement: Blood and muscle share a pathway label.
Unsafe upgrade: The same genes changed or one tissue signalled to the other.

Safe statement: An early phosphosite and later target-motif signal are temporally compatible.
Unsafe upgrade: The phosphosite caused the later transcriptional response.

Safe statement: A plasma protein matches tissue RNA/protein in time and direction.
Unsafe upgrade: The tissue is proven to be the source of the plasma protein.

Safe statement: A PLIER LV is associated with a pathway prior.
Unsafe upgrade: The pathway caused the LV or independently validates it.

Safe statement: RNA for a gene rose after one bout.
Unsafe upgrade: The protein rose, or will rise.

Safe statement: A gene is "protein-only" in one contrast.
